description: A posted tariff of 5 or below FAILS the alert gate. Inverted from a high tariff: the note IS persisted to charge_points.fault_note and alerted_at stays NULL. The audit detail is still written, by the generic diff loop rather than by the gate.

phases.label: ground fault, cheap tariff
sql: UPDATE charge_points SET tariff='OFFPEAK' WHERE id=1

body.nt: ALERT: GROUND FAULT on phase A

SELECT fault_note FROM charge_points WHERE id=1
